latest_release.body:
- Bump aiounifi to v98 ([@bhamiltoncx] - [#190145]) ([unifi docs]) (dependency)
- Fix HomeKit camera motion events never reaching HomeKit ([@RaHehl] - [#190440]) ([homekit docs])
- Add new entities to restored sleeping Shelly RPC devices on wake ([@thecode] - [#190447]) ([shelly docs])
- Bump broadlink-async to 1.2.1 ([@DAB-LABS] - [#190471]) ([broadlink docs]) (dependency)
- Bump opower to 0.23.0 ([@tronikos] - [#190486]) ([opower docs]) (dependency)
- Make nexia set_hvac_run_mode fields optional ([@frenck] - [#190498]) ([nexia docs])
- Bump googlewifiapi to 0.1.3 ([@gittastic] - [#190515]) ([google_wifi docs]) (dependency)
- Mark SimpliSafe sensors unavailable when reported offline ([@frenck] - [#190501]) ([simplisafe docs])
- Bump aioamazondevice to 17.2.7 ([@jamesonuk] - [#190576]) ([alexa_devices docs]) (dependency)
- Bump pylamarzocco to 2.5.5 ([@zweckj] - [#190580]) ([lamarzocco docs]) (dependency)
- Bump pylamarzocco to 2.5.6 ([@zweckj] - [#190624]) ([lamarzocco docs]) (dependency)
- Prefer the cloud model over Bluetooth in La Marzocco ([@zweckj] - [#190623]) ([lamarzocco docs])
- Bump ZHA to 2.4.3 ([@puddly] - [#190645]) ([zha docs]) (dependency)
- Close devices when Home Assistant stops for Midea ([@chemelli74] - [#190640]) ([midea docs])
- Use serial proxy URL builder for ESPHome capabilities API ([@puddly] - [#190430]) ([esphome docs])
- Validate the MQTT payload encoding and handle an unknown encoding on receive ([@jbouwh] - [#190539]) ([mqtt docs])
- Bump pyvesync to 3.5.0 ([@chemelli74] - [#190701]) ([vesync docs]) (dependency)
- Bump holidays to 0.108 ([@gjohansson-ST] - [#190725]) ([holiday docs]) ([workday docs]) (dependency)
- Bump xknx to 4.1.1 ([@farmio] - [#190766]) ([knx docs]) (dependency)
- Bump zm-py to 0.5.12 ([@nabbi] - [#190768]) ([zoneminder docs]) (dependency)
- Only fetch account's read resolution on Opower incremental updates ([@tronikos] - [#190808]) ([opower docs])
- fix vesync missing modes ([@cdnninja] - [#190803]) ([vesync docs])
- Revert removal of energy log sensors for myuplink ([@astrandb] - [#190696]) ([myuplink docs])
- Use PowerState for the first power check after setup for SamsungTV ([@chemelli74] - [#190882]) ([samsungtv docs])
- Update frontend to 20261028.5 ([@bramkragten] - [#190925]) ([frontend docs]) (dependency)
- Delay La Marzocco settings refresh after firmware update ([@zweckj] - [#190926]) ([lamarzocco docs])
- Add mm to homee units ([@lazerg] - [#190649]) ([homee docs])
- Map ESPHome climate defrosting action ([@jjprz] - [#189776]) ([esphome docs])
- Fix Agent DVR alarm panel update when no profile is active ([@ispysoftware] - [#191023]) ([agent_dvr docs])
- Skip duplicate device probe after key validation in Midea ([@chemelli74] - [#191041]) ([midea docs])
- Fix Tomorrow.io never polling after setup ([@raman325] - [#191017]) ([tomorrowio docs])
- Bump velbus-aio to 2026.11.0 ([@cereal2nd] - [#191095]) ([velbus docs]) (dependency)
- Bump aiovitesy to 1.4.8 ([@chemelli74] - [#191098]) ([vitesy docs]) (dependency)
- Bump knx-frontend to 2026.11.8.11926 ([@farmio] - [#191159]) ([knx docs]) (dependency)
- Bump aiowebostv to 1.0.1 ([@thecode] - [#191134]) ([webostv docs]) (dependency)
- Log Marketplace rate limit connection errors without a traceback ([@janvt] - [#191093]) ([marketplace docs])
- Bump python-google-maps-routing-api to 0.0.4 ([@tronikos] - [#191234]) ([google_travel_time docs])
- Bump python-google-drive-api to 0.2.1 ([@tronikos] - [#191233]) ([google_drive docs])
- Bump python-google-weather-api to 0.0.10 ([@tronikos] - [#191235]) ([google_weather docs])
- Bump androidtvremote2 to 0.3.3 ([@tronikos] - [#191214]) ([androidtv_remote docs]) (dependency)
- Fetch the Marketplace README again after an install or uninstall ([@alexhass] - [#191129]) ([marketplace docs])
- Bump lorawan-connection to 1.3.1 ([@balloob] - [#191052]) ([chirpstack docs]) ([lorawan docs]) ([thethingsnetwork_lorawan docs]) (dependency)
- Bump renaul
